title: Filing: a Chinese company says a fund in which its unit invested paid ~$420M for an indirect 0.8265% stake in DeepSeek, implying DeepSeek is valued at ~$52B (Eduardo Baptista/Reuters)
summary: Eduardo Baptista / Reuters: Filing: a Chinese company says a fund in which its unit invested paid ~$420M for an indirect 0.8265% stake in DeepSeek, implying DeepSeek is valued at ~$52B — China's Anhui Korrun (300577.SZ) said a fund in which its subsidiary invested deployed 2.90 billion yuan for an indirect 0.8265% stake in DeepSeek …
